title: The light is Way to bright
text: The light is Way to bright. This blind was brighter than my old shade. I had to take it down. If you want it darker this isn’t your product

product_metadata.title: LUCKUP 3 Pack Cordless Light Filtering Pleated Fabric Shade,Easy to Cut and Install, with 6 Clips (36"x72" - 3 Pack, Black)
features: Material properties: The material of the temporary blinds is 100% non-woven fabric--safe, non-toxic, breathable and environmentally friendly. It can block some of the ultraviolet and harmful dust, to provide a comfortable environment for the family. Provide protection for your healthy life.
Design concept: The appearance of the room darkening pleated shades is simple and atmospheric--no bead chain, no curtain line, children and pets avoid the risk of being entangled in the chain.

Easy to Install: The installation of our cordless shades only requires three steps--cutting, tearing and sticking. It can save a lot of complicated installation tools like drills. At the same time achieves no holes, no fixing, no hassle.
Easy to cut: Adjust the size of the light filtering shades by cutting the shades. It's not a challenge, everything is simple and casual. No one will find it difficult.

Easy to clean: If there is dust on the pleated fabric shades, wipe it with a rag or feather duster to keep it clean and new. It only takes a few minutes to complete the cleaning. And it has better durability than paper shades.
